verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API, the same one it uses internally. The docs cover personal API key and OAuth2 auth, example queries and mutations, schema introspection, a no-login Apollo Studio explorer, published rate limits, a deprecation policy and a typed TypeScript SDK. Webhooks are registrable via the webhookCreate mutation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the API in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
The Linear Typescript SDK exposes the Linear GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations.
call the webhookCreate mutation with the teamId (or allPublicTeams: true) and url of your webhook
